matthew.22.p1.b1.text: Once again, Jesus spoke to them in parables:

matthew.22.p1.b2.text: “The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.

matthew.22.p1.b3.text: He sent his servants to call those he had invited to the banquet

matthew.22.p2.b1.text: Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner. My oxen and fattened cattle have been killed, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.

matthew.22.p2.b2.text: But they paid no attention and went away, one to his field, another to his business.

matthew.22.p3.b1.text: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them, and killed them.

matthew.22.p3.b3.text: and he sent his troops to destroy those murderers and burn their city.

matthew.22.p4.b1.text: The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited were not worthy.

matthew.22.p4.b2.text: Go therefore to the crossroads and invite to the banquet as many as you can find.’

matthew.22.p4.b3.text: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered everyone they could find, both evil and good

matthew.22.p4.b4.text: and the wedding hall was filled with guests.

matthew.22.p5.b1.text: But when the king came in to see the guests

matthew.22.p5.b2.text: he spotted a man who was not dressed in wedding clothes.

matthew.22.p5.b3.text: Friend … how did you get in here without wedding clothes?

matthew.22.p6.b1.text: Tie him hand and foot, and throw him into the outer darkness

matthew.22.p6.b2.text: where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

matthew.22.p6.b3.text: For many are called, but few are chosen.”

matthew.22.p7.b1.text: Then the Pharisees went out and conspired to trap Jesus in His words.

matthew.22.p7.b2.text: They sent their disciples to Him along with the Herodians.

matthew.22.p7.b3.text: Teacher … we know that You are honest and that You teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.

matthew.22.p7.b4.text: So tell us what You think: Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”

matthew.22.p8.b1.text: You hypocrites, why are you testing Me?

matthew.22.p8.b2.text: Show Me the coin used for the tax.

matthew.22.p8.b3.text: And they brought Him a denarius.

matthew.22.p8.b4.text: Whose image is this … and whose inscription?

matthew.22.p9.b3.text: Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.

matthew.22.p9.b4.text: And when they heard this, they were amazed. So they left Him and went away.

matthew.22.p10.b1.text: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him.

matthew.22.p10.b2.text: Teacher … Moses declared that if a man dies without having children, his brother is to marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.

matthew.22.p10.b3.text: Now there were seven brothers among us … The same thing happened to the second and third brothers, down to the seventh.

matthew.22.p10.b4.text: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be of the seven?

matthew.22.p11.b1.text: You are mistaken because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.

matthew.22.p11.b2.text: In the resurrection, people will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.

matthew.22.p12.b1.text: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what God said to you:

matthew.22.p12.b2.text: I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob

matthew.22.p12.b3.text: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

matthew.22.p12.b4.text: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at His teaching.

matthew.22.p13.b1.text: And when the Pharisees heard that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they themselves gathered together.

matthew.22.p13.b2.text: One of them, an expert in the law, tested Him with a question:

matthew.22.p13.b3.text: “Teacher, which commandment is the greatest in the Law?”

matthew.22.p14.b1.text: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.

matthew.22.p14.b2.text: This is the first and greatest commandment.

matthew.22.p14.b3.text: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’

matthew.22.p14.b4.text: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.”

matthew.22.p15.b1.text: While the Pharisees were assembled, Jesus questioned them:

matthew.22.p15.b2.text: What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is He?

matthew.22.p16.b1.text: How then does David in the Spirit call Him ‘Lord’? For he says

matthew.22.p16.b2.text: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.”’

matthew.22.p16.b3.text: So if David calls Him ‘Lord,’ how can He be David’s son?”

matthew.22.p16.b4.text: No one was able to answer a word, and from that day on no one dared to question Him any further.
